narrative: Today's technology brief highlights significant advancements in AI, with Adobe integrating AI assistants into creative suites, Midjourney expanding into medical imaging, and major players like Google, OpenAI, and NVIDIA unveiling new AI models and infrastructure. Cybersecurity remains a critical concern, evidenced by a massive Fortinet breach and Cloudflare's new security offerings. Additionally, space exploration continues with NASA announcing a public-private partnership for a Mars mission and new Hubble observations.

highlights.title: Photoshop and Premiere now have AI assistants
highlights.whyItMatters: Adobe's integration of AI assistants into its creative suite signifies a major shift in how creative professionals will interact with their tools, promising enhanced automation and efficiency.

highlights.title: Midjourney goes from generating cat images to full-body ultrasound scans
highlights.whyItMatters: Midjourney's pivot to medical imaging with ultrasound-based full-body scanners demonstrates the rapid and diverse application of AI in critical sectors like healthcare.

highlights.title: Two-thirds of Americans think AI is advancing too quickly
highlights.whyItMatters: Public perception of AI's rapid advancement reveals societal concerns about its pace and potential implications, which could influence future regulatory landscapes.

highlights.title: NVIDIA Blackwell Leads on First Agentic AI Infrastructure Benchmark
highlights.whyItMatters: NVIDIA's leading performance on the new AgentPerf benchmark indicates significant progress in hardware optimization for advanced agentic AI workloads, crucial for the next generation of AI systems.

highlights.title: Waymo recalls nearly 4,000 robotaxis to stop them driving into highway construction zones
highlights.whyItMatters: The recall of Waymo robotaxis highlights ongoing safety challenges and the complexity of deploying autonomous vehicle technology in dynamic real-world environments.

highlights.title: NASA picks Eric Schmidt’s rocket company for Mars mission, setting up a race with SpaceX
highlights.whyItMatters: NASA's partnership with Relativity Space for a Mars mission signifies a growing trend in public-private collaborations for ambitious space exploration, potentially accelerating advancements.

highlights.title: Massive breach spills credentials for thousands of sensitive networks
highlights.whyItMatters: A significant cybersecurity breach impacting major companies underscores the persistent and evolving threat landscape, necessitating continuous vigilance and robust security measures.

highlights.title: Introducing Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base for faster, more accurate enterprise AI applications
highlights.whyItMatters: AWS's new Bedrock feature streamlines the development of enterprise AI applications, making advanced AI capabilities more accessible and efficient for businesses.
